title: 24 May 1963: Live: Granada Cinema, Walthamstow, London
content:
Day six of their UK tour with Roy Orbison, and The Beatles performed at the Granada Cinema in Walthamstow, London. The concert took place shortly after the recording of the first Pop Go The Beatles programme for the BBC.

The Beatles are likely to have performed an eight-song set: ‘Some Other Guy’, ‘Thank You Girl’, ‘Do You Want To Know A Secret’, ‘Love Me Do’, ‘From Me To You’, ‘Please Please Me’, ‘I Saw Her Standing There’, and ‘Twist And Shout’.

This was the first Beatles concert at the Granada Cinema. They returned there on one other occasion, on 24 October 1964.
